source: NTSB historical public database derivatives preserved by third parties

anchors.artifact: complete NTSB online AviationData download used by AirSafe analysis
documented_properties: AirSafe states the complete NTSB database was downloaded on 2016-09-04 and contained just under 79,000 records.
The transformation preserves NTSB Event.Date separately from Publication.Date.
The linked original text/XML downloads and transformed outputs were made publicly available with the dated analysis.
anchors.pit_use: Potential record-level anchor for fields demonstrably preserved in the 2016 download, subject to byte acquisition/hash and record-by-record comparison. Publication.Date is a candidate record publication field and must be validated against NTSB semantics before admission.
limitations: AirSafe is a secondary distributor, not the competent NTSB archive.
No byte hash has yet been recorded in BSFM.
This anchor cannot establish values or fields added after the 2016 download.
Publication.Date must not be promoted to available_at until its semantics are independently confirmed and the relevant record exists in the preserved snapshot.

g3_effect: No PASS by itself. Secondary anchors may corroborate exact historical field/value presence but cannot silently replace source-specific verification rules.
